Sample negatives only inside the 10 exhaustive blocks; elsewhere unlabeled ink is not confirmed negative
Exclude the 226 off-plate and 140 blank-plate polygons from mask generation
Review the 15 modern_proxy_suspect polygons and 10 landmarks not on ink
Do not mix with the road-graph line task
